title: 示例 · ESP32 GPIO 点亮 LED
summary: ESP32 的任意一个输出 GPIO → 220 Ω → LED → GND，引脚设为“输出高电平”。
concepts: pin current limit 引脚电流上限
description:
把 ESP32 开发板插在面包板上（USB 供电）。选一个能输出的 GPIO（例如 GPIO2；GPIO34–39 只能输入），串一个 220 Ω 电阻和一个红色 LED 到 GND，在属性里把这个引脚设成 **输出高电平**。

引脚电流 I = (3.3 − 1.8) / (220 + 25 + 12) ≈ **5.8 mA**，远低于 20 mA 的建议上限。

en.title: Example · ESP32 GPIO lights an LED
en.summary: Any output-capable ESP32 GPIO → 220 Ω → LED → GND, with the pin set to output HIGH.
en.description:
Plug the ESP32 board into the breadboard (powered from USB). Pick an output-capable GPIO (e.g. GPIO2; GPIO34–39 are input-only), wire a 220 Ω resistor and a red LED to GND, and set the pin to **output HIGH** under Properties.

The pin current is I = (3.3 − 1.8) / (220 + 25 + 12) ≈ **5.8 mA**, well below the 20 mA recommendation.
hints: GPIO → resistor → LED anode (long leg); LED cathode → GND.
Select the board and set the pin's mode to output HIGH.
tests: Output HIGH: the LED is on and the pin gives 5–7 mA
Output LOW: the LED is off

tests.name: 输出高电平：LED 亮，引脚电流 5–7 mA

hints: GPIO → 电阻 → LED 长脚（正极）；LED 短脚 → GND。
选中开发板，把引脚模式设为“输出高电平”。
